theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_diag_rescaled_radon_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (Vi : ℕ → Varifold N n U) (V : Varifold N n U) (ξ : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ) (F : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), Varifold.RadonConverges Vi V → 0 < t → (∀ z ∈ tsupport F, ξ + t • z.1 ∈ U) → Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ z, F z ∂(rescaledMeasure (Vi i) ξ t)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ z, F z ∂(rescaledMeasure V ξ t)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
